title: Tobacco Consumption Patterns
question: How are cigarette prices and recorded per-capita packs associated?
caveat: Repeated states and two historical periods; nominal prices and policy confound associations.
action: Deflate prices and use a panel design before estimating elasticities.
method: Complete-pair scatter plot of price and packs, with Pearson and Spearman correlations. No regression adjustment or causal claim.
